title: Honest near-misses & limits
purpose: Elite portfolios state failure modes. Use these in interviews before claiming perfection.

items.near_miss: accuracy_when_diagnosed ≈ 78% on confirmed impairments; mixed loss+cpu often returns insufficient_evidence by design.
items.lesson: Withholding is better than a confident wrong network attribution.

items.near_miss: Early CI showed delay injectors with unchanged RTT because localhost bypassed veth/netem.
items.lesson: Client and server must be in separate netns so packets traverse the impaired path.

items.near_miss: DuckDB+Parquet teaches medallion/CDC/SRM invariants without Spark, Unity Catalog, or Iceberg catalogs.
items.lesson: Say 'teaching lakehouse' — not 'I ran Netflix ExP'.

items.near_miss: SNR/BER/eye/jitter/FEC/Link Health Score are pinned teaching curves, not BERT/DCA/PIC characterization.
items.lesson: Vocabulary + category errors (netem≠BER) are the elite signal; claim silicon only if you have bench data.

items.near_miss: I&C integrity + physics-result store are didactic. Not NQA-1, SCADA, or real multiphysics kernels.
items.lesson: Lead with missing≠zero and reproducibility identity — the invariants Oklo postings care about.
